svg.title: Spiral Ascent: a three-way king of the hill map
svg.desc: Three terraces, each walled by a cliff with one ramp per team, every ramp a third of the way further round than the one below. Your road to the hill spirals clockwise and climbs its last ramp in front of your neighbour. Bots can cut across on foot tracks; vehicles have to go the long way.
svg.text: Three-way king of the hill · 16 × 16 map (8192 game units square) · 1v1v1 to 2v2v2
Three terraces, each walled by a cliff with one ramp per team, every ramp a third of the way further
round than the one below. Your road to the hill spirals clockwise and climbs its last ramp in front of
your neighbour. Bots can cut across on foot tracks; vehicles have to go the long way.
Heights: outer ground 200 · first terrace 290 · second terrace 380 · the summit (the hill) 460
Planet Halite · a world of salt terraces
Ground: white and pink salt crusts on the terraces, layered rose-grey rock in the terrace walls,
cracked salt-pan polygons on the summit.
Plants: none on the salt; a few ad0_senegal palms only out at the map's edge.
Features: pilha_crystal_quartz clusters along the terrace walls, pilha_crystal_red and
pilha_crystal1 on the summit, rocks30_snow (white) as salt boulders.
Sky and weather: pale sky, bright glare, thin white haze; wind 10 to 24; tidal 0.
Each third is the same, turned 120° about the hill. Heights in game units; lighter ground stands higher.
